text: dsh-acp 是面向 Zed 等桌面编辑器的 DSH 插件，通过 ACP 和 JSON-RPC stdio 连接编辑器与 DSH agent。它管理会话创建、恢复和提示，并将消息、工具调用、文件差异与终端结果转换为编辑器更新。用户可在编辑器中查看历史、切换模型、使用斜杠命令，并为会话配置 preset 或 MCP 服务。适合希望从兼容 ACP 的 IDE 操作 DSH agent 的开发者；需要安装兼容版本的 DSH 与 Node.js。

dsh-acp connects Zed and other editors to DSH agents via ACP over JSON-RPC stdio. It manages sessions and prompts, then displays messages, tool calls, diffs, and terminal results. Users can review history, switch models, and configure presets or MCP servers. It requires compatible DSH and Node.js.

dsh-acp 的功能「ACP 会话管理」：在编辑器端创建、恢复、列出和关闭 DSH agent 会话，并支持提示与取消。通过 ACP session 请求触发，返回会话标识及配置选项。
dsh-acp 的功能「编辑器状态更新」：把 agent 消息、思考片段、工具调用和工具结果转换为 ACP 更新；工具更新可带路径、行号和终端输出。由 DSH 会话事件触发，输出供 IDE 展示的结构化内容。
dsh-acp 的功能「模型与推理设置」：为 ACP 会话提供模型和 reasoning effort 选项，可在会话配置请求中更改。设置变化影响后续提示，当前进行中的 turn 保持已接纳时的模型路由。
dsh-acp 的功能「MCP 服务接入」：会话请求可附带 stdio 或 Streamable HTTP MCP 服务声明；插件校验配置后，在该 agent 的隔离作用域挂载 MCP 客户端和工具。

@cnctem/dsh-acp README · dsh-acp：> [简体中文](docs/README.zh.md) · [技术文档 / Technical notes](docs/technical.md)

An **Agent Client Protocol (ACP)** server for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (`dsh`) that lets [Zed](https://zed.dev) and other editors drive dsh agents over **JSON-RPC 2.0 stdio**.

@cnctem/dsh-acp README · dsh-acp：The shipped dsh `acp` profile is intentionally automation-only. This bundle is a drop-in replacement for its bridge: it keeps the standard automation surface (sessions, MCP, model selection, permissions) and adds the editor experience Zed needs on top.

@cnctem/dsh-acp README · Introduction：`dsh-acp` mounts one ACP server on dsh stdin/stdout. Zed launches `dsh --profile acp`; the plugin translates `session/*` requests into dsh Agent lifecycles. Installing this bundle requires no Zed configuration change because it disables both the shipped `acp` bridge and startup row, then mounts this implementation and the same stdin-lifetime provider under unique ids.

@cnctem/dsh-acp README · Features：- **Standard ACP lifecycle** — `initialize`, `session/new`, `session/list`, `session/resume`, `session/close`, `session/prompt`, and `session/cancel`
- **Lazy empty sessions** — `session/new` is provisional: the Agent, preset/MCP mounts, and durable session begin only after the first accepted prompt, while the slash-command catalog is already advertised so `/` works on the first message
- **Editor history extensions** — `session/load` replays durable history; `session/delete` closes a live session and removes its persisted artifact when the backend exposes deletion
- **Token & thinking streaming** — `agent/assistant-stream` frames projected as `agent_message_chunk` / `agent_thought_chunk`
- **Tool cards** — `tool_call` / `tool_call_update` with kind, file location and line
- **Structured diffs** — native tool hunks plus before/after file snapshots
- **Bash terminal** — command output rendered as terminal content with exit code
- **Context-usage ring** — `usage_update` (used / size)
- **Todo list** — dsh `todo_write` snapshots rendered as the stable ACP `plan` update
- **Goal in the task list** — the current goal leads the ACP `plan` (`Goal: … · Rou

@cnctem/dsh-acp README · Installation：Prerequisites: Node.js `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0`, `dsh@0.2.1-rc.2`, and `pnpm`.

```bash
dsh plugin --profile acp add @cnctem/dsh-acp
```

From source:

```bash
git clone https://github.com/cnctem/dsh-acp.git
cd dsh-acp
pnpm install
pnpm run build

Existing installs upgrade with the same command; the effective `acp` profile now contains the custom bridge instead of the automation-only bridge.

@cnctem/dsh-acp README · Configuration：- `DSH_ACP_PROVIDER` / `DSH_ACP_MODEL` override the default provider/model. Unset values follow dsh `agent-default-model`.
- `DSH_ACP_PRESET` selects the process-level agent composition. Unset or empty uses the registry default, `standard`.
- Built-in presets:
  - `standard` — coding tools, plan mode, todos, web, subagents.
  - `ptc` — standard tools plus presentation/code-runtime behavior.
  - `minimal` — a persistent shell and minimal persona.
  - `cordis` — creation mode with plugin-manager and Cordis inspection tools plus the bundled authoring skills.
- The old `$DSH_HOME/.agent-presets/<id>` directory scan is no longer supported. Presets are ordinary `@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-preset` declarations in this bundle and can be overridden by a later profile patch.
- API keys reuse dsh credentials (`$DSH_HOME/.credentials.yaml`, account auth, or `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY`).

@cnctem/dsh-acp README · Development：Source lives in `src/`; TypeScript generates committed ESM, declarations, and source maps in `lib/`.

```bash
pnpm run typecheck
pnpm test              # hermetic in-process protocol smoke
pnpm run test:profile  # real dsh profile acceptance in a temporary DSH_HOME
pnpm run verify        # typecheck + smoke + generated-lib freshness

`pnpm run test:profile` requires a working `dsh` executable. Set `DSH_BIN` to test another binary.
